name: @flatironinstitute/treeweave
description: Adaptive piecewise-polynomial function approximation — JS/TS binding (native N-API addon + WASM) over the treeweave C ABI.

scripts.build:native: cmake --preset bindings-js && cmake --build build/bindings-js -j --target treeweave_node treeweave_js_ts
scripts.build:wasm: cmake --preset bindings-js-wasm && cmake --build build/bindings-js-wasm -j --target treeweave_wasm treeweave_js_ts
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm
